detail.longDescription:
Agent Hub is a comprehensive tool designed exclusively for Aflac agents and administrators. Developed with significant input from the Aflac field force,  Agent Hub is continually evolving to better serve the needs of Aflac producers and policyholders. Stay tuned for more features coming soon!

• Effortlessly file claims for your clients, including wellness claims, with our streamlined process. The "Similar Claim" feature saves time by allowing you to file multiple wellness claims consecutively.
• Access detailed profiles of Accounts, Policyholders, Policies, Riders, Claims, and Benefits. Use shortcuts to quickly make claims from the policyholder profile and verify Aflac Always setup.
• Seamlessly nominate new recruits to expand your team and increase commissions.
• Submit and track inquiries about missed benefits with ease.
• Stay informed about the service your policyholders are receiving by tracking all your submitted claims.
• Our agents have played a huge role in the redesign and functionality of this app, ensuring it meets your needs on the go.

Download Agent Hub today to get started. Learn more about Aflac at www.aflac.com.
